$comment: Local MCP servers, registered at user scope by install.sh / install.ps1.
Secrets are ${ENV_VAR} placeholders — never commit real tokens here.
Claude Code expands ${VAR} from the environment when it launches the server,
so export them in your shell profile (see config/.env.example).
claude.ai connectors (Google Drive, Gmail, Google Calendar, n8n, Canva,
Lovable, PlayMCP, Upwork) are account-level, NOT local config. They follow
your Anthropic account to the Mac automatically — just re-authorize each one
from claude.ai connector settings after signing in.
